label: SS26 coherent flooring demo
phase: Priority SS26 original three-tab app; separate from R67 experiment

northport.name: Northport White Oak Distressed Water Resistant Engineered Hardwood
northport.reason: High in-stock run-rate, but intermittent stockouts constrained season sales: -29.3% vs LY. Strong local demand and lower full-season sales can coexist. Validate supply before increasing the buy.

definitions.scope: Illustrative SS26 Flooring, 72 canonical style-colour rows and 45 stores. Not client actuals.
definitions.sales: Signed net sales in USD; all tables and charts aggregate the same canonical style-colour facts.
definitions.quantity: Synthetic selling units; pack size and canonical flooring UOM require F&D confirmation.
definitions.r4Sales: Synthetic net sales in the last 4 completed prototype weeks ending 26 Jul 2026; fiscal calendar definition TBC.
definitions.r13Sales: Synthetic net sales in the last 13 completed prototype weeks ending 26 Jul 2026; fiscal calendar definition TBC.
definitions.r52Sales: Synthetic net sales in the last 52 completed prototype weeks ending 26 Jul 2026; fiscal calendar definition TBC.
definitions.salesPerSqFt: Season net sales / allocated selling area in sq ft. Area allocation and whether F&D intends selling-area productivity or another measure are definition TBC. This is not selling-unit AUR.
definitions.plrBaseline: Synthetic original approved SS26 sales target, frozen at 8.8M for this demo; not a recovered client PLR.
definitions.planRevenue: Synthetic latest SS26 sales plan, 8.6M for the full scope; distinct from original PLR baseline.
definitions.sellThrough: Synthetic season net sold units / season available supply units. Inventory opening, receipts and adjustment policy are definition TBC.
definitions.stocks: Single synthetic end-of-season snapshot at 31 Jul 2026. Stock is not summed over weeks.
